 CW By Carol Warner 
 Read it on Beacon Share Last updated November 20, 2026 1 min read 
 Effective Jan. 1, 2027, Vermont’s minimum wage will increase from $14.42 to $14.91 an hour. That is a 49-cent increase, or $19.60 more per 40-hour workweek.
 And for tipped employees, the minimum wage will rise from $7.21 to $7.46 an hour. State law sets the tipped minimum at 50% of the full minimum wage, and the department rounded half of $14.91 ($7.455) up to $7.46.
 Both rates are adjusted annually under Vermont law and take effect at the start of the new year.
 More info: VT DOL announcement
